title: CatalogItemChangedPayload
description: Payload of `catalog.item.changed` version 1: an item of a store's catalogue changed. The envelope's `partner_id` is the store's partner. The payload names the item and what kind of change it was, never the values; readers fetch the item. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

change.description: What kind of change: the item `created`, `updated` through its form, `deleted` or `duplicated` (the copy is the item named), or its `stock`, a `price`, the questions it asks (`modifiers`) or the categories it sits on.

revision.description: The catalogue's revision after the change, raised by every change; the version of the `catalog.changed` signal on the store's catalogue channel.
